title: Spanish-Style Chicken & Rice Skillet with Sweet Peppers and Peas
summary: A mild, paella-inspired one-skillet meal with kosher chicken thighs, rice, sweet bell peppers, and peas. Entirely dairy-free, with 45 minutes total and about 25–30 minutes active.
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb kosher boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1-inch pieces
1 1/2 cups short-grain white rice (not instant), rinsed and drained
2 1/2 cups kosher-certified pareve chicken broth (add a little more if rice needs it)
1/4 tsp turmeric or a small pinch of saffron (optional)
instructions: Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces and season with salt, pepper, and half the sweet paprika. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a deep, lidded skillet over medium-high heat; brown chicken 4–5 minutes, stirring, then transfer to a plate. It will finish cooking with the rice.
Add remaining olive oil, onion, and bell peppers. Cook 4–5 minutes until starting to soften. Stir in garlic, remaining paprika, optional smoked paprika and turmeric/saffron for 30 seconds.

Stir in rice to coat, then add crushed tomatoes and broth. Bring to a simmer, nestle chicken and its juices into the rice, cover and cook over low heat for 18–22 minutes without frequent stirring. Check near the end; add a splash of hot broth or water if the rice is dry before tender.
Scatter peas over the rice, cover and cook 3–5 minutes more, until peas are hot, rice is tender, and the chicken reaches 165°F in its thickest pieces.
Rest covered off heat for 5 minutes. Fluff lightly, finish with parsley if using, and serve with lemon wedges.
child_friendly_modifications: Keep the paprika mild and omit smoked paprika if sensitive. Set aside a little rice and chicken before squeezing on lemon. Serve chicken cut into small pieces, with peas and tender pepper strips separated; mash peas if needed for the younger child. Avoid large hot bites and let rice cool before serving.
leftovers: Cool rice and chicken promptly in shallow containers and refrigerate within 2 hours. Eat within 3–4 days, reheating until steaming hot/165°F. Reheat with a splash of water in a covered skillet. Leftovers can become a warm rice bowl with diced cucumber and lemon.
